title: Creating, working with, and saving Colab notebooks

cues.en: In this video, I will introduce you to using the colab environment that is provided by Google and connects
cues.zh: 這支影片，會介紹 Google 提供的 Colab 環境，它不只連接

cues.en: to not only Python back end, but also GPUs that we can use for investigating and building and training large language models.
cues.zh: Python 後端，也能連接 GPU，讓我們研究、建立、訓練大型語言模型。

cues.en: Okay, so to get to Colab, first of all, you need a Google account that is free to open and then you can go to Colab.research.google.com.
cues.zh: 好，要使用 Colab，首先需要 Google 帳號，可以免費申請，再到 colab.research.google.com。

cues.en: Or you can just Google search for Colab research, and then you will find it and you open up a new notebook and you will get something that looks like this.
cues.zh: 也可以搜尋 Colab research，找到後，開啟新筆記本，就會看到像這樣的畫面。

cues.en: It's always very intimidating to see these empty files, whether it's like a word doc and you have to write something or a code file.
cues.zh: 看到空白檔案，總是很令人畏懼，不管是要寫東西的 Word 文件，還是程式碼檔。

cues.en: But don't worry, we will fill all this stuff in with beautiful, amazing code.
cues.zh: 但不用擔心，我們會用漂亮、精彩的程式碼填滿。

cues.en: Okay, so this is one option to go directly to this website
cues.zh: 好，這是一種方式，直接到這個網站。

cues.en: You can also open up new notebook files in Colab if you are in Google Drive.
cues.zh: 如果在 Google 雲端硬碟，也可以開新的 Colab 筆記本檔案。

cues.en: So here I'm at my drive.
cues.zh: 這裡是我的雲端硬碟。

cues.en: I've created a folder for this LM course and now there's nothing in here.
cues.zh: 我為這門 LLM 課建立資料夾，目前裡面沒有東西。

cues.en: But I am going to right click and more and then you will see Google Colab.
cues.zh: 按右鍵，選「更多」，就會看到 Google Colab。

cues.en: So that is just another way to automatically create an empty Python notebook file in this folder.
cues.zh: 這是另一種在這個資料夾，自動建立空白 Python 筆記本的方法。

cues.en: And then it will immediately open it up in Colab, like what you see here.
cues.zh: 接著，就會立刻用 Colab 開啟，像這樣。

cues.en: Okay, so if this is your first time ever looking at a colab notebook, then I encourage you to take
cues.zh: 好，如果第一次看 Colab 筆記本，鼓勵你花

cues.en: a few minutes just to browse around and see what is available in these notebooks.
cues.zh: 幾分鐘逛逛，看看筆記本提供什麼。

cues.en: So for example, we can go to open we can open a new notebook.
cues.zh: 例如，可以到「開啟」，開新筆記本。

cues.en: So you have several possibilities for opening notebooks.
cues.zh: 有幾種開啟筆記本的方式。

cues.en: You can open an existing notebook from your Google Drive.
cues.zh: 可以從 Google 雲端硬碟，開啟現有筆記本。

cues.en: This is useful when you already have several notebooks available.
cues.zh: 已經有幾份筆記本時，這很有用。

cues.en: Here's a nice feature we can cancel this.
cues.zh: 這裡有個好功能，可以先取消。

cues.en: Don't actually need to connect to GitHub right now.
cues.zh: 目前不需要真的連接 GitHub。

cues.en: So if you select GitHub then here you can enter a GitHub repo.
cues.zh: 選 GitHub 後，可以在這裡輸入 GitHub repo。

cues.en: So for example I will just search for my own.
cues.zh: 例如，搜尋我自己的。

cues.en: And here so this is for my GitHub site.
cues.zh: 這裡是我的 GitHub 網站。

cues.en: And then you can see all the repos that I have here.
cues.zh: 可以看到，我所有 repo。

cues.en: So for example I don't know let's do uh this one calculus book.

cues.zh: 現在，可以點其中一個檔案。

cues.en: And that will just automatically open.
cues.zh: 它會自動開啟。

cues.en: So it pulls the notebook file off of GitHub and it will open it here.
cues.zh: 從 GitHub 取得筆記本檔案，在這裡開啟。

cues.en: So then yeah we can start working with this notebook file here that I have gotten from GitHub.
cues.zh: 接著，就能開始使用這份從 GitHub 取得的筆記本。

cues.en: Now don't worry if you make changes here.
cues.zh: 如果在這裡修改，不用擔心。

cues.en: That's not actually going to change the file on my GitHub.
cues.zh: 不會真的改到我 GitHub 上的檔案。

cues.en: You can save this after modifying it, you can save it locally.
cues.zh: 修改後可以儲存，也可以存在本機。

cues.en: Okay, but that's not what I want to do here.
cues.zh: 好，但這不是這裡要做的。

cues.en: What I want to do is just open up a fresh notebook here.
cues.zh: 我想做的是開一份全新筆記本。

cues.en: So I'm going to close this.
cues.zh: 所以，關掉這個。

cues.en: It's giving me a warning message because I've made changes but that's fine.
cues.zh: 因為有修改，出現警告訊息，但沒關係。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So here I have my beautifully titled, very clear titled notebook here.
cues.zh: 這裡有個標題優美、非常清楚的筆記本。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Anyway, so that was about opening notebooks.
cues.zh: 總之，這是開啟筆記本。

cues.en: Um, you can also, once you've been working on a notebook, you can save a copy in your Google Drive.
cues.zh: 使用筆記本一段時間後，也可以在 Google 雲端硬碟儲存副本。

cues.en: If you have a GitHub account, you can save it directly in GitHub.
cues.zh: 如果有 GitHub 帳號，也可以直接存到 GitHub。

cues.en: You can also download the file either as a notebook or as a raw Python file.
cues.zh: 也能下載成筆記本，或原始 Python 檔。

cues.en: To be honest, if you are watching this video then it means you are probably fairly new, maybe completely new, but at least a little bit new to Python.
cues.zh: 老實說，如果正在看這支影片，代表你可能對 Python 還相當新，也許完全沒接觸，至少還有點陌生。

cues.en: In which case I recommend not worrying about downloading to locally and also not worrying about saving to a GitHub.
cues.zh: 那我建議，先別擔心下載到本機，也別擔心儲存到 GitHub。

cues.en: Instead, I recommend keeping all these files organized on your Google Drive.
cues.zh: 而是把所有檔案整理在 Google 雲端硬碟。

cues.en: Certainly for now it just makes things a little bit easier.
cues.zh: 至少目前，會比較容易。

cues.en: Other menu options you probably don't really need to worry about here is a relevant one.
cues.zh: 其他選單選項，大概不太需要擔心。這裡有個相關的。

cues.zh: 點「執行階段」。

cues.en: Then we look down to the option change runtime type.
cues.zh: 再往下看「變更執行階段類型」。

cues.en: So by default you get connected to a CPU.
cues.zh: 預設會連到 CPU。

cues.en: So we're not yet connected to a CPU, but we will in a moment.
cues.zh: 目前還沒有連，但稍後就會。

cues.en: And that is going to connect us to Python.
cues.zh: 那會讓我們連接 Python。

cues.zh: Google Colab 也支援其他語言。

cues.en: But here we're only going to be working with Python.
cues.zh: 但這裡只會使用 Python。

cues.en: Uh, yeah.
cues.zh: 對。

cues.en: So by default you get access to a CPU, which is great for lots and lots of applications, lots and lots of explorations.
cues.zh: 預設能使用 CPU，對非常多應用、探索都很好。

cues.en: Once we start getting into working with large, large language models, then we're going to need to switch to GPUs.
cues.zh: 開始使用很大的大型語言模型後，就需要改成 GPU。

cues.en: Now depending on your location and whether you pay for Colab Pro, you might only see you know.
cues.zh: 視所在地區，以及是否付費訂閱 Colab Pro，可能只看到，

cues.en: You might not see as many GPU options here, but you'll certainly have at least one GPU option.
cues.zh: 也許沒有這麼多 GPU 選項，但一定至少有一種 GPU 選項。

cues.en: And so yeah, I'll talk about this more later in the course.
cues.zh: 課程後面會再多談。

cues.en: But basically, when you are working with these really large deep learning models, you really need to use the GPU.
cues.zh: 基本上，處理非常大的深度學習模型時，真的需要 GPU。

cues.en: This is going to be the difference between waiting seconds versus waiting hours for your model to process.
cues.zh: 模型處理等待時間，可能是幾秒與幾小時的差別。

cues.en: Okay, but all that said, if you do not need to use a GPU, then you should stick to the CPU.
cues.zh: 好，但如果不需要 GPU，就應該維持 CPU。

cues.en: The CPU is better to connect to unless you really need the GPU.
cues.zh: 除非真的需要 GPU，否則連 CPU 比較好。

cues.zh: 所以，
